title: Paul's ascent to the third heaven

tellings.quote: Some scholars even believe that the Apostle Paul may have been familiar with these practices and he described his own celestial ascent to the third heaven in the second Corinthians

plain: The Apostle Paul, in his Second Letter to the Corinthians, describes his own ascent through the heavens to "the third heaven", and some scholars believe he may have known the mystical practices of heavenly ascent of his day. Michels brings this up himself, citing unnamed scholars, to suggest that experiences of rising into other realms have deep roots in early Christianity.
